The WWTF consists of a collection system, two aerated ponds (Ponds 1 and 3), one unaerated pond (Pond 2), chlorination facilities, a storage reservoir, and the LAAs.
Hypochlorite is injected to the Pond 3 effluent at the output of the storage reservoir transfer pumps.
The storage reservoir is used for storage of treated and disinfected effluent.
Wastewater is applied to approximately 85 acres of the 125-acre site.
Sludge is hauled off site to a permitted landfill.
Additional chlorination for odor control may take place at the irrigation pumps.
The Discharger may move the disinfection system to the Pond 3 outlet to allow disinfected effluent to bypass the storage reservoir and be discharged directly to the LAAs.
